name: Channel names — a voice says each channel on its own output
description: Eight spoken samples from the SAMPLES folder (*Left, *Right, *Drums, *Vocals, *Bass, *Guitar, *Piano, *Other). Row 0 says them in turn, one bar apart, each on its own output: Left and Right on outputs 1 and 2 (the two clips are stereo files with the voice on one side only, played on a channel that has no amp), then Drums on m10 (output 12), Vocals m11 (output 11), Bass m13, Guitar m14, Piano m15, Other m16. Rows 1-8 are one channel each: press 1-8 to hear a single name; a row of only samples plays once per press. The audio is played by this page, not by Logic. On a device with fewer than 16 outputs every name comes out in stereo (Left and Right still on their own side).
prompt: a sample file for each channel, a voice saying the 8 channel names, and an MPL that sends them in sequence to each channel
